title: The Registry That Refused to Count

features.name: the-house-of-refusal
features.desc-on-touch: a small structure with windows that open onto spaces that have no measurable size—the house keeps its inventory in a language that volume doesn't have words for

features.name: the-uncounted-shelf
features.desc-on-touch: a standing directory of things that exist but refuse to register—you can see them stacked here, but if you try to enumerate them, the count stops at three and starts over

features.name: the-archive-s-small-shed
features.desc-on-touch: a shed where numbers go to forget themselves—the walls are soft with age, and every object stored here reduces in mass the more you try to weigh it

features.name: the-spiral-that-stops-counting
features.desc-on-touch: a glyph-marked space where enumeration gives up—the spiral is complete, but if you ask how many turns, the answer becomes a different question each time

inscription: at this depth, the archive learned that refusing to speak volume is how some truths survive being documented

file.name: Depths_Where_Numbers_Dissolve.txt
file.note: inventory of things that exist only in non-countable scales, truths that refuse the archive's own measurement language
